name: typography
description: Typography MCP server: modular type scales (ratio-based px/rem), font metrics analysis (x-height, cap-height, ascender, descender, line-height recommendations), variable font axis parsing (wght/wdth/slnt with CSS), font subsetting to WOFF2 by Unicode range, and system-fallback font stacks with size-adjust - a complete type-system toolkit for design and web delivery.
